query_phrases: construction_start_date

columns.retrieval_gloss: The calendar date when the construction of the nuclear power plant commenced. Stored as text in ISO 8601 format.

query_phrases: Country
The sovereign state or geopolitical entity where the nuclear power plant is located. Used to group and filter plants by national jurisdiction.
columns.retrieval_gloss: The sovereign state or geopolitical entity where the nuclear power plant is located. Used to group and filter plants by national jurisdiction.

columns.retrieval_gloss: A unique identifier for a nuclear power plant record within the GeoNuclearData schema. Although declared as text, observed values are sequential integers, suggesting an auto-incrementing surrogate key.

query_phrases: last_updated_at

columns.retrieval_gloss: The geographic latitude coordinate of the nuclear power plant, expressed in decimal degrees. Values represent position north or south of the equator.

columns.retrieval_gloss: The geographic longitude coordinate of the nuclear power plant, typically expressed in decimal degrees. Used to define the east-west position on Earth's surface.

columns.retrieval_gloss: The proper name of a nuclear power plant, potentially including a site identifier or suffix in parentheses. Used to uniquely identify individual plants within the dataset for counting and aggregation purposes.

query_phrases: operational_start_date

columns.retrieval_gloss: The date when the nuclear power plant began commercial operation or became fully operational. Stored as text in ISO 8601 format.

columns.retrieval_gloss: The date on which the nuclear power plant ceased commercial operation or was decommissioned. Null or empty values likely indicate plants that are still operational.

query_phrases: reactor_model
The specific design, type, or model of the nuclear reactor installed at the power plant. Examples include VVER variants and BN fast breeder reactors.
columns.retrieval_gloss: The specific design, type, or model of the nuclear reactor installed at the power plant. Examples include VVER variants and BN fast breeder reactors.

query_phrases: reactor_type

columns.retrieval_gloss: The technical classification of the nuclear reactor design used at the power plant, such as Pressurized Water Reactor or Fast Breedered Heavy Water Reactor.

columns.retrieval_gloss: Indicates the origin or reference used to compile the nuclear power plant data record. Values represent organizations like the World Nuclear Association (WNA) or International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), sometimes combined with Wikipedia.

query_phrases: plant_status
